## Data and predictors

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mgcv)
library(lubridate)

df <- read.csv("C:/Users/mbkro/OneDrive/Documents/wetland-ml-models/data/daily_wetlands_dataset.csv")
stopifnot(all(c("Site", "Datetime") %in% names(df)))

if (anyNA(df$Datetime)) stop("Datetime contains missing/unparseable dates; check input date format.")

responses <- c("mean_WT", "max_WT", "range_WT")
stopifnot(all(responses %in% names(df)))

predictor_groups <- list(
  Solar    = c("Solar_daily", "Solar_2d", "Solar_3d", "Solar_7d"),

  Air_tmean = c("Air_tmean", "Air_tmean_2day", "Air_tmean_3day", "Air_tmean_7day"),
  Air_tmax = c("Air_tmax", "Air_tmax_2day", "Air_tmax_3day", "Air_tmax_7day"),
  Air_tmin = c("Air_tmin", "Air_tmin_2day", "Air_tmin_3day", "Air_tmin_7day"),
  GWT_mean = c("GWT_mean", "GWT_mean_2day", "GWT_mean_3day", "GWT_mean_7day"),
  GWT_max  = c("GWT_max", "GWT_max_2day", "GWT_max_3day", "GWT_max_7day"),
  GWT_min  = c("GWT_min", "GWT_min_2day", "GWT_min_3day", "GWT_min_7day"),

static_predictors <- c(
  "Air_trange", "WL_daily_range", "GWT_range", "GWL_range",
  "Water_area_m2_3d"
)

```

## GAM predictor selection

Temporal representations are compared using five-fold week-blocked CV and common complete-case observations within each predictor group.

```{r}
make_gam_weekly_folds <- function(data, k = 5, seed = 42) {
  week_id <- lubridate::floor_date(as.Date(data$Datetime), unit = "week", week_start = 1)
  weeks <- unique(week_id)
  if (length(weeks) < k) {
    stop("Not enough distinct weeks for ", k, "-fold GAM CV (found ",
         length(weeks), ").")
  }
  set.seed(seed)
  weeks <- sample(weeks)
  week_groups <- split(weeks, rep(seq_len(k), length.out = length(weeks)))
  lapply(week_groups, function(w) which(week_id %in% w))
}

select_gam_predictors_site <- function(train_data, response_var,
                                       k_folds = 5, seed = 42) {
  stopifnot(length(unique(stats::na.omit(train_data$Site))) == 1)
  if (!response_var %in% names(train_data)) stop("Missing response: ", response_var)

  purrr::imap_dfr(predictor_groups, function(vars, group_name) {
    existing <- intersect(vars, names(train_data))
    if (!length(existing)) return(tibble::tibble())

    # Compare candidates on the same complete-case observations.
    repeat {
      common <- train_data %>%
        dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c("Datetime", response_var, existing))) %>%
        tidyr::drop_na()
      if (!length(existing) || nrow(common) < 10) break
      eligible <- vapply(existing, function(v) {
        is.numeric(common[[v]]) &&
          length(unique(common[[v]])) >= 2
      }, logical(1))
      if (all(eligible)) break
      existing <- existing[eligible]
    }
    if (!length(existing) || nrow(common) < 10) {
      warning("Skipping group ", group_name, " for ", response_var,
              ": insufficient complete observations or variation.")
      return(tibble::tibble())
    }
    if (length(unique(lubridate::floor_date(common$Datetime,
                 unit = "week", week_start = 1))) < k_folds) {
      warning("Skipping group ", group_name, " for ", response_var,
              ": fewer than ", k_folds, " distinct weeks.")
      return(tibble::tibble())
    }

    folds <- make_gam_weekly_folds(common, k = k_folds, seed = seed)
    scores <- purrr::map_dfr(existing, function(v) {
      predictions <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(common))
      for (holdout in folds) {
        training <- common[-holdout, , drop = FALSE]
        n_unique <- length(unique(training[[v]]))
        # Use a smooth when sufficient unique values are available.
        form <- if (n_unique >= 5) {
          stats::as.formula(paste0(response_var, " ~ s(`", v, "`, k = 5)"))
        } else {
          stats::reformulate(v, response = response_var)
        }
        fit <- mgcv::gam(form, data = training, method = "REML")
        predictions[holdout] <- as.numeric(stats::predict(
          fit, newdata = common[holdout, , drop = FALSE]
        ))
      }
      tibble::tibble(predictor = v,
                     cv_rmse = sqrt(mean((common[[response_var]] - predictions)^2)))
    })
    scores %>%
      dplyr::arrange(cv_rmse, match(predictor, existing)) %>%
      dplyr::slice(1) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(group = group_name, n = nrow(common), .before = 1)
  })
}

# Called on training data within each outer CV fold by the modeling script.
select_for_local_site <- function(train_data, response_var, k = 5, seed = 42) {
  selection <- select_gam_predictors_site(train_data, response_var,
                                          k_folds = k, seed = seed)
  statics <- intersect(static_predictors, names(train_data))
  statics <- statics[vapply(statics, function(v) {
    x <- train_data[[v]]
    is.numeric(x) && length(unique(x[is.finite(x)])) >= 2
  }, logical(1))]
  list(predictors = unique(c(selection$predictor, statics)),
       selection = selection)
}
```

## Final local-model datasets

These full-data selections are for final refits. The modeling script runs selection separately within each outer training fold for performance evaluation.

```{r}
sites <- sort(unique(stats::na.omit(df$Site)))
site_response_data <- list()
selection_rows <- list()
summary_rows <- list()

for (s in sites) {
  df_site <- df %>% dplyr::filter(Site == s)
  site_response_data[[s]] <- list()

  for (resp in responses) {
    result <- select_for_local_site(df_site, resp, k = 5)
    chosen <- result$predictors
    base_cols <- c("Site", "Datetime", resp)
    final_df <- df_site %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(unique(c(base_cols, chosen))))
    site_response_data[[s]][[resp]] <- final_df

    selection_rows[[length(selection_rows) + 1L]] <-
      result$selection %>% dplyr::mutate(Site = s, response = resp, .before = 1)
    summary_rows[[length(summary_rows) + 1L]] <- tibble::tibble(
      Site = s, response = resp,
      n_predictors = length(chosen),
      predictors = paste(chosen, collapse = "; ")
    )
  }
}

site_gam_selection <- dplyr::bind_rows(selection_rows)
site_selection_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(summary_rows)
print(site_selection_summary)
```

## Save outputs

```{r}
output_dir <- "C:/Users/mbkro/OneDrive/Documents/wetland-ml-models/data/local_mod_data"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) stop("Output directory does not exist: ", output_dir)

for (s in names(site_response_data)) {
  for (resp in names(site_response_data[[s]])) {
    fn <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(s, "_", resp, "_model_data_revised.csv"))
    utils::write.csv(site_response_data[[s]][[resp]], fn, row.names = FALSE)
  }
}

utils::write.csv(site_gam_selection,
                 file.path(output_dir, "site_gam_selection_revised.csv"),
                 row.names = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(site_selection_summary,
                 file.path(output_dir, "site_selection_summary_revised.csv"),
                 row.names = FALSE)

selected_long <- purrr::imap_dfr(site_response_data, function(by_response, site) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(by_response, function(dat, resp) {
    predictors <- setdiff(names(dat), c("Site", "Datetime", resp))
    tibble::tibble(Site = site, response = resp, predictor = predictors)
  })
}) %>% dplyr::arrange(Site, response, predictor)

utils::write.csv(selected_long,
                 file.path(output_dir, "site_model_selected_predictors_long_revised.csv"),
                 row.names = FALSE)
```

## Outer-fold selection frequency

Summarize selections exported by the local modeling script.

```{r local_outer_fold_frequency}
selection_path <- file.path(
  "C:/Users/mbkro/OneDrive/Documents/wetland-ml-models",
  "results", "local_results", "local_gam_fold_selections_revised.csv"
)

stopifnot(file.exists(selection_path))

fold_sel <- readr::read_csv(selection_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

local_frequency <- fold_sel %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Site, Metric, Set, fold, group, predictor) %>%
  dplyr::count(Site, Metric, Set, group, predictor,
               name = "n_selected") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Site, Metric, Set, group,
                 dplyr::desc(n_selected))

print(local_frequency, n = Inf)

readr::write_csv(
  local_frequency,
  file.path(dirname(selection_path),
            "supp_local_temporal_selection_frequency.csv")
)
```
